metadata.mappingStrategy: Maps session.created, pre_llm_call, message.delta, and post_llm_call conservatively; internal prompt/hook/tool lifecycle remains aggregated or inferred.

projectionLossDetails.reason: providerBoundary is recorded with per-request visibility from cli-event evidence.
streamDelta is recorded with semantic visibility from stream-event evidence.
toolLifecycle is recorded with call-result visibility from cli-event evidence.
messageWrite is recorded with storage-event visibility from message-store evidence.
acceptance is recorded with explicit-event visibility from runtime-policy evidence.
workspace is recorded with diff-only visibility from workspace-diff evidence.
